flows.name: Inspect RAG vectorization throughput
steps: Open the selected source lifecycle view
flows.expectedOutcome: The dashboard shows live vectorization counts for meetings, Teams messages, emails, and documents, then links each source to its scoped RAG lifecycle records.

checks: The chart has four source bars

claims.description: Counts read from the RAG lifecycle source of truth.
The range controls and source drill-down work at desktop and mobile widths.
